The forced comparison retains infinite cumulative strain and, in a planar direction, gives a globally smooth witness whose initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero while its output has a fixed \(L^2\) escape. R0.73P closes the critical stability and band-limited input interface around a fixed global strong trajectory: the critical tube is valid for all starting times, the \(N^{-1/2}\) exponent is exact for norm transfer, and it permits smooth perturbations whose \(L^2\) norm tends to zero while \(H^3\) diverges. All weak branches in the energy ball become regular after a common delay and synchronize relative to the reference trajectory; what remains inaccessible is the preceding early weak interval. This section uses the periodic Stokes--HLS bilinear estimate and a finite Volterra recurrence to construct a critical heat-flow stability tube uniform in the starting time. An exact Fourier family proves that it adds smooth safe data outside the old \(H^{1/2}\) tube; a time-endpoint counterexample blocks the bare Kato supremum. Whole-space Besov openness belongs to the established literature, and the Clay conclusion remains open. I assess the current value of R0.73R as “a reliable bridging lemma and counterexample tool,” not a high-level regularity theorem. What remains useful is the separation of energy, additive geometry, and high-order phase into layers; a rigorous certificate reproducible from finite Fourier data; and a same-spectrum deterministic family showing that quadratic energy spectra are insufficient. This section actually completes three narrower but usable tasks. The bounded collision search did not locate an identical package of “scalar energy-density autocorrelation \(A Q\) + two exact nonautonomy witnesses,” but a finite search is not proof of novelty or priority. This site calls it only a locally auditable synthesis. My assessment of R0.73U is that it does not solve global regularity, but it separates the two information gaps left by R0.73T. The real threshold on this route is not another higher-order identity, but new, non-circular signed control from the energy class. That threshold has not yet been crossed.
